title: An internet that follows the sun
subject: Low-tech Magazine's solar-powered website
context: What if a website didn't need to be available all the time? Low-tech Magazine reduced its website's energy requirements through lightweight pages and deliberately simple design. Extended cloudy weather can take the solar-powered version offline.

credits.name: Kris De Decker

related.note: The website runs on sunlight and can go offline in long cloudy spells; the Strandbeests walk only when the wind blows.

editorialNotes: Credits follow the site's own 'About the solar powered website' page (2026-11-25).
